name: sanity-template-nextjs-clean
description: Next.js + Sanity: A Powerful Website Starter with Real-time Visual Editing

scripts.import-sample-data: cd studio && sanity dataset import sample-data.tar.gz --dataset production --replace

_overridesComment: Re-check on each sanity upgrade and delete any override upstream has fixed. js-yaml must stay pinned to a 3.x: with a range npm dedupes it to eslint's hoisted 4.x, which drops the safeLoad API that @vercel/frameworks calls. The remaining moderate audit findings are all adm-zip inside the Sanity CLI toolchain (@sanity/runtime-cli -> @sanity/cli-build), which cascade to everything depending on sanity. adm-zip has no fixed release — the advisory covers >=0.5.9 and 0.6.0 is latest — and it only runs during studio build/deploy, never in the shipped app.
